title: Aletris Farinosa
text: This remedy is especially indicated in cases of extreme debility and lack of vital force, particularly in women. It is useful in cases of anaemia and digestive disorders. There is a general feeling of weariness and exhaustion. It is often called 'the china of the uterine organs.' Confused and forgetful. Depression and anxiety. Appetite poor. Nausea. Disgust for food. Heaviness in the stomach. Distended with gas. Flatulence. Chronic constipation. Uterine debility. Leucorrhoea. Prolapse of the uterus. Habitual miscarriage. Compare: Helonias; China; Hydrastis. Tincture to third potency.
